scope: Process and RemoteComposition native Windows prerequisites only. Model, assumptions, fairness and checked bounds unchanged. Creation-time job membership, NTFS custody and admission order require exact-head native executable evidence; not proved by the finite models.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/main.rs.inspection: Windows CLI dispatch uses inspected configuration before initializing a node layout. Other platforms keep the existing loader.

crates/coconutclaw-config/src/lib.rs.inspection: Read-only inspection of the selected directory precedes config file parsing and layout initialization.

crates/coconutclaw-config/src/lib_tests..inspection: A refused inspection precedes parsing malformed TOML and leaves only the original file.

crates/coconutclaw-provider/Cargo.toml.inspection: Remove obsolete ToolHelp binding; no new dependency or lockfile change.

crates/coconutclaw-provider/src/lib.rs.inspection: Use the creation-time Windows launch path; retain stdin/stdout/stderr and existing timeout, result and cancellation logic.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/nodes.rs.inspection: Inspect config before parse, check resolved database parent and existing layout inputs before creation, require private output directory at dispatch.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/nodes/tests.r.inspection: Live dispatcher refuses missing, reparse and broad-ACL output directories and resumes only with private custody restored.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/tests/nodes_cli.r.inspection: Real node CLI refuses unsafe or missing custom SQLite parent and untrusted malformed config before creating layout; private custom parent control succeeds.

crates/coconutclaw-provider/src/windows..inspection: CreateProcessW with required job-list and stdio handle-list attributes; no fallback spawn or suspended unowned process.

crates/coconutclaw-provider/src/windows/.inspection: Existing descendant and abrupt owner death tests use the native launcher; query membership against its specific job handle.

crates/coconutclaw-config/src/windows_se.inspection: Require private directory DACL and reject reparse components before traversing them. Only planned layout paths may be missing.
